note: Public copies of accepted application screenshots. crop = [left, top, right, bottom] in source pixels. Every crop removes the left navigation (it shows a development sign-in address and a random test-project name); nothing inside the kept region is edited. V2.1: every screenshot that came from the MnDOT sample exports (whose origin, terms and redistribution permission are not yet documented) was replaced by a screenshot of the SYNTHETIC demonstration project; the samples stay restricted and are not shown. Entries with "interface": "verniqel" were taken from the running rebranded build (docs/screenshots/verniqel/, synthetic demo data); all other entries show the interface before the VERNIQEL rebrand and are captioned so.
